correctness.rationale: Orthonormal eigenvectors turn restrictions SU and SV into independent isotropic s-Gaussians. Numerator ||SAb||^2>0 simultaneously for all nonzero b almost surely (full rank on 2-plane). The denominator is b^T H b for H with diagonals mu||U||^2 and L||V||^2 and off-diagonal (mu+L)U·V/2 divided by s. Sylvester gives H>0 iff cosine²(U,V)<4kappa/(kappa+1)^2; H indefinite otherwise except measure-zero equality. Gaussian spherical cosine² has Beta(1/2,(s-1)/2), giving the probability. Its monotonicity and CLT yield sharp uniform row budget: at s/kappa=t, probability tends to 2Phi(2sqrt t)-1; the strict inverse threshold follows by sandwich. For fixed s, beta density at zero gives the stated Gamma prefactor kappa^{-1/2}. Independently checked low-row exact beta expressions at kappa=2,10,100 and Sylvester algebra; no false implication from a fixed b to a uniform b.

value.rationale: This is an exact, motivated stability precondition for a sketched harmonic extraction algorithm: protecting an entire two-mode invariant plane using one shared random sketch has a sharp linear-in-condition-number row cost, unlike condition-independent informal guarantees. Precise probability and confidence constant are useful design facts, without pretending to prove the full restarted algorithm converges.

final_claim: For any fixed two-eigenmode plane of real SPD A with condition number kappa>1 and one shared iid N(0,1/s) sketch with integer s>=2, probability that all one-dimensional sketched harmonic Ritz values are defined and positive is I_{4kappa/(kappa+1)^2}(1/2,(s-1)/2). The minimal s achieving confidence >=1-delta scales as [Phi^{-1}(1-delta/2)]^2*kappa/4.
